evaluation_basis: Assessed for frozen train/validation/final-test execution and honest search-aware interpretation; candidate selection prevents treating final point estimates as confirmed alpha.
original_objective: Compare causal Ichimoku/rule candidates and IRGC-S meta-labeling on BTC/ETH 4h archives with 2025 as untouched final test.

engineering_result.summary: Causal next-open rules, no displaced-future Ichimoku features, explicit costs, risk caps, drawdown firewall and committed result tables were produced.

scientific_result.summary: S6 advanced only as a forward-observation hypothesis because it emerged from candidate search; IRGC-S had only one positive OOS fold and was rejected.

economic_result.summary: S6 final test: BTC +3.53%, Sharpe 0.831, MDD -3.42%; ETH +5.06%, Sharpe 1.207, MDD -3.24%. IRGC-S: -0.46%, PF 0.943, MDD -3.59%.

contribution_to_next_version: Separated an attractive S6 point result from confirmation and motivated cost-aware/external replication tests.
